svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="T_Txx3Xaxb4ICrfqFrLV"> <mxGraphModel dx="857" dy="-603" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data":"@startuml
skinparam actorStyle awesome
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam usecase {
 BackgroundColor #EEFAF5
 BorderColor #0D9488
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 11
}
skinparam actor {
 BackgroundColor #D0F5EC
 BorderColor #0D9488
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontSize 12
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam package {
 BackgroundColor #F5FDFB
 BorderColor #6DD4C4
 FontColor #1A2235
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam arrow {
 Color #0D9488
 FontColor #0D9488
 FontSize 10
}

left to right direction

' ── Actors ───────────────────────────────────────
actor \"Student\" as Student #LightSalmon
actor \"Admin\" as Admin #LightSteelBlue
actor \"Gemini AI Engine\" as Gemini #Plum
actor \"FAISS RAG Engine\" as FAISS #LightGoldenRodYellow

rectangle \"AI Chatbot Module\" {

 package \"FAQ Management (Admin)\" {
 usecase \"Create FAQ\nEntry\" as UC_CreateFAQ
 usecase \"Update / Delete\nFAQ Entry\" as UC_EditFAQ
 usecase \"View All\nFAQs\" as UC_ViewFAQ
 }

 package \"Chatbot Interaction (Student)\" {
 usecase \"Send Message\nto Chatbot\" as UC_Send
 usecase \"Start / Resume\nChat Session\" as UC_Session
 usecase \"View Chat\nHistory\" as UC_History
 usecase \"Submit Session\nFeedback & Rating\" as UC_Feedback
 usecase \"End Chat\nSession\" as UC_End
 }

 package \"RAG Pipeline\" {
 usecase \"Fetch Real-Time\nStudent Data\" as UC_FetchData
 usecase \"Search FAQs via\nFAISS Similarity\" as UC_FAISS
 usecase \"Build Context\nfor Gemini\" as UC_Context
 }

 package \"Gemini Response Generation\" {
 usecase \"Generate AI\nResponse\" as UC_Generate
 usecase \"Return Formatted\nResponse to Student\" as UC_Return
 usecase \"Save Message\nto Database\" as UC_Save
 }
}

' ── Student Associations ─────────────────────────
Student --> UC_Send
Student --> UC_Session
Student --> UC_History
Student --> UC_Feedback
Student --> UC_End

' ── Admin Associations ───────────────────────────
Admin --> UC_CreateFAQ
Admin --> UC_EditFAQ
Admin --> UC_ViewFAQ

' ── Gemini Engine Associations ───────────────────
Gemini --> UC_Generate
Gemini --> UC_Return

' ── FAISS Engine Associations ────────────────────
FAISS --> UC_FAISS
FAISS --> UC_Context

' ── Include / Extend ─────────────────────────────
UC_Send .> UC_Session : <<include>>
UC_Send .> UC_FetchData : <<include>>
UC_FetchData .> UC_FAISS : <<include>>
UC_FAISS .> UC_Context : <<include>>
UC_Context .> UC_Generate : <<include>>
UC_Generate .> UC_Return : <<include>>
UC_Return .> UC_Save : <<include>>
UC_End .> UC_Feedback : <<extend>>

@enduml","format":"svg"}" id="14pVjtuajESJFR7WagT--21"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1272" width="468" x="20" y="1100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
